# PromptBill (https://promptbill.online)

> LLM Leaderboard, Individual Model Specs, Head-to-Head Comparisons, Provider Hubs, Best Coding LLMs & Cost Calculators.

## Routes
- / (Leaderboard & Score/$ Matrix)
- /pricing (30-Day API Cost, Caching, Batch, Retries & SaaS Margin Calculator)
- /best-llms-for-coding (Best LLMs Ranked for Coding & Agentic Tasks)
- /models/[slug] (Individual Model Benchmarks, Rate Limits & Calculator)
- /compare/[model-a]-vs-[model-b] (Head-to-Head Model Comparisons)
- /providers/[provider] (Provider Model Directories)
- /tools/llm-selector (Workload Model Selector)
- /tools/token-counter (Prompt Token Counter)
- /tools/routing-simulator (Hybrid Routing Savings Simulator)
- /deals (API Savings & Pro Pass)
- /methodology (Scoring & Pricing Methodology)
- /advertise (Sponsorships)
